components: small closed head flowing into a broad leftward bowl
strokeOrder: loop clockwise around the small closed head
continue left through the broad bowl without lifting
lift once, then place the upper dot

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, ف demonstration at 02:09–02:13 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated ف body-first: loop clockwise around the small closed head, continue left through the broad bowl without lifting, then lift once and place the single dot above. Contextual joins shorten the bowl; this isolated learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and records Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the independently verified Arabic or Urdu ف sources.

notes: Fā carries one dot above; its isolated bowl is shallower than qāf ق.
